line-art.best_for: 图标、小插图、流程图元素、装饰性小图
line-art.medium: HB pencil on off-white sketchbook paper, thin broken lines, slightly wobbly hand-drawn strokes, visible paper grain, faint construction lines left visible
line-art.shading: contour only, no shading, no fill
line-art.composition: empty paper background, generous negative space, 30-second quick sketch feel

hatched-tonal.best_for: 通用配图，绝大多数场景的默认选择
hatched-tonal.medium: 2B graphite pencil on cream paper, dense cross-hatching in shadow areas, sparse hatching in midtones, paper white reserved for highlights, thick slightly imperfect outlines, visible paper grain texture, subtle smudging
hatched-tonal.shading: clear three-tone structure (light / midtone / shadow), cast shadow grounding the subject
hatched-tonal.composition: mostly empty cream paper with a faint horizon line

charcoal-rough.best_for: 沉重、冲突、批判性主题；人物肖像特写
charcoal-rough.medium: charcoal stick and 6B pencil on textured paper, broad smudged shadow masses, aggressive hatching, dusty paper grain, edges dissolving into the paper, visible eraser lift-outs in highlight areas
charcoal-rough.shading: dramatic single light source, deep dark shadows, high contrast, raw unfinished tonal masses with visible midtone hatching
charcoal-rough.composition: near-empty textured paper, a few scattered charcoal dust specks, raw and unfinished feel

pencil-wash.best_for: 生活化、温暖、怀旧内容；食物、家居、旅途
pencil-wash.medium: graphite line work with visible hatching, overlaid by one soft {accent} watercolor wash that bleeds outside the lines, cream watercolor paper texture, slightly wobbly hand-drawn outlines
pencil-wash.shading: soft diffused daylight, gentle shading, paper white as highlight
pencil-wash.composition: pale wash fading into empty paper at the edges

urban-sketch.best_for: 地点、空间、流程场景、建筑、街景
urban-sketch.medium: fine liner and graphite pencil on cream sketchbook paper, loose hatching for shade under eaves and objects, wobbly architectural lines, visible paper grain, a few annotation marks and arrows in the margins
urban-sketch.shading: soft daylight with cast shadows, light gray washes
urban-sketch.composition: one-point perspective, eye-level viewpoint, foreground detail fading to simplified background shapes, small human figures for scale

conceptual.best_for: 金句卡底图、观点配图、抽象主题
conceptual.medium: graphite pencil on cream paper, cross-hatched shading, thick expressive outlines, visible paper grain, subtle smudging
conceptual.shading: strong directional light from upper left, deep blacks in shadow, crisp midtone hatching, paper white as the brightest highlight, cast shadow grounding the subject
conceptual.composition: single centered subject anchored in the lower two thirds of the frame, the upper third is completely empty paper with absolutely no objects, props or clock, no decoration at the top, minimal environment, one small symbolic prop kept below the upper third

square.use: 文章内嵌配图 / 头像 / 方形卡片

landscape.use: 封面 / banner / PPT / 横版底图

portrait.use: 小红书 / 手机壁纸 / 金句卡

wide.use: 横向流程图 / 全景速写

lighting.upper-left: single soft light source from upper left
lighting.upper-right: single soft light source from upper right
lighting.dramatic: dramatic single light source, deep dark shadows, high contrast

color_rules.with_accent: monochrome graphite with one muted {accent} accent color
color_rules.background: cream / off-white / light gray paper (never pure white #ffffff)

negative_block: no photorealistic rendering, no 3D render, no CGI, no oil painting, no plastic or glossy surface, no neon colors, no hard gradients, no airbrushed smoothness, no stock photo look, no heavy digital filters, no full saturated color, no comic-book flat color fill, no watermark, no garbled text
quality_block: hand-drawn sketchbook illustration, clean composition, balanced visual weight, editorial illustration quality
